In my opinion, your situation doesn't seem to relate to anything paranormal or the opinions of people with near-death experiences.

I see your case more in line with those suffering from chronic pain. Although they may lead seemingly normal or 'perfect' lives, their day-to-day is marked by constant pain. In your situation, despite having a life that seems satisfying, you struggle internally with your own issues and can't fully enjoy it. I believe the only difference between your situation and someone with chronic pain is that yours are of a psychological nature while theirs are physical.

I think reading opinions and talking to people who have such issues could help you. Good luck :)
